findings.description: In Response.__init__, self.raw is still None when this line runs, so self.raw.reason raises AttributeError and every Response() construction fails.
findings.rationale: Trigger: any call to Response() with no arguments, which runs the constructor, including the library's own uses and tests. Mechanism: __init__ assigns self.raw = None earlier in the method, so the attribute access on None fails before the object is initialized. Impact: constructing a Response crashes instead of returning an object with reason None or an empty string.
